paths.@prismalens/database: the engine must not depend on @prismalens/database — it stays db-clean per ADR-0011.
paths.@prismalens/integrations: the engine must not depend on @prismalens/integrations — that couples it to app-side external services.
paths.@prismalens/auth: the engine must not depend on @prismalens/auth — that couples it to the app's auth layer.
paths.@prismalens/api: the engine must not depend on @prismalens/api — that couples it to the app.
paths.@prismalens/frontend: the engine must not depend on @prismalens/frontend — that couples it to the app.

patterns.message: the engine must not reach into packages/api or packages/frontend via relative import — that breaks the extraction seam.
